title: Warm Buttery Peruvian Chicken Pollo A La Brasa
description: This Peruvian dish is a hangover cure featuring tender chicken, savoy cabbage, and a blend of spices, all infused with buttery goodness. It is a satvik-friendly pollo a la brasa recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic, ginger, and aji amarillo pepper into a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, peruvian spices, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pounded paste to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and coat with the butter and spice mixture.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 30 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the shredded savoy cabbage.
Cook the cabbage until it is tender and slightly caramelized, about 20 minutes.
After the chicken has baked for 30 minutes, brush it with the pan juices and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the cooked savoy cabbage and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
